exercises.title: Constrain byId so it can use the id
concepts: type-level mutation: wrong calls must be refused
exercises.problemHtml:
byId reads item.id but T is unconstrained, so it does not compile. Add <T extends { id: number }>. The correct calls (Repo of users, of labs-with-id) must still keep their type; a type without an id must be refused.

Done when: tsc clean on src + kiem/dung.ts, kiem/sai.ts refused, test passes.

Requirements

  • Edit src/byid.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/byid.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS2345); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/byid.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bas\s+(?!const\b), \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, [\w$)\]]!(?=[.\[;,)\s]).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
byId đọc item.id nhưng T không ràng buộc, nên không biên dịch. Thêm <T extends { id: number }>. Các lời gọi đúng (user, lab-có-id) vẫn phải giữ kiểu; một kiểu không có id phải bị từ chối.

Đạt khi: tsc sạch trên src + kiem/dung.ts, kiem/sai.ts bị từ chối, test qua.

Yêu cầu

  • Sửa src/byid.ts. Các tệp còn lại (test, kiem/…, tệp phụ) là của máy chấm: nó luôn dùng bản gốc.
  • tsc với tsconfig của khoá (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) báo 0 lỗi trên tệp của bạn + kiem/dung.ts, test/byid.test.ts.
  • Mỗi dòng của kiem/sai.ts kết thúc bằng // expect TSxxxx bị từ chối với đúng mã đó (TS2345); các dòng khác vẫn biên dịch.
  • node --test test/byid.test.ts thoát với mã 0 — Node 22 chạy tệp .ts bằng cách bỏ kiểu.
  • Không dùng lối tắt bị cấm trong tệp của bạn: \bas\s+(?!const\b), \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, [\w$)\]]!(?=[.\[;,)\s]).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is in the Solution tab, with comments on every type it adds. It passes because the grader checks the same three things as the course's own checker (scripts/ts/kiem-de-ts.mjs): the files compile under the strict course tsconfig, every wrong call in the grader's files is refused with the expected error code, and the program still behaves the same when Node strips the types and runs it.

The usual wrong answers — constraint { id: string } — rejects numeric-id users for the wrong reason — each fail at least one of those checks: see "Common mistakes".

exercises.title: getProp with keyof and indexed access
concepts: type-level mutation: wrong calls must be refused
exercises.problemHtml:
getProp is typed any, so a misspelled key is not caught and the return type is lost. Write getProp<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K): T[K].

Done when: tsc clean on src + kiem/dung.ts, the typo in kiem/sai.ts is TS2345, test passes.

Requirements

  • Edit src/get.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/get.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS2345); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/get.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bas\s+(?!const\b), \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, [\w$)\]]!(?=[.\[;,)\s]).

exercises.title: pluck keeps the property type
concepts: type-level mutation: wrong calls must be refused
exercises.problemHtml:
pluck should return an array of the chosen property’s type: pluck(users, 'id') is number[]. It is typed any[], so a wrong key slips and the result type is lost. Write pluck<T, K extends keyof T>(items: readonly T[], key: K): T[K][].

Done when: tsc clean on src + kiem/dung.ts, kiem/sai.ts refused, test passes.

Requirements

  • Edit src/pluck.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/pluck.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS2345); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/pluck.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bas\s+(?!const\b), \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, [\w$)\]]!(?=[.\[;,)\s]).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

Đạt khi: tsc sạch trên src + kiem/dung.ts, kiem/sai.ts bị từ chối, test qua.

  • node --test test/pluck.test.ts thoát với mã 0 — Node 22 chạy tệp .ts bằng cách bỏ kiểu.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is in the Solution tab, with comments on every type it adds. It passes because the grader checks the same three things as the course's own checker (scripts/ts/kiem-de-ts.mjs): the files compile under the strict course tsconfig, every wrong call in the grader's files is refused with the expected error code, and the program still behaves the same when Node strips the types and runs it.

The usual wrong answers — key: string, returns unknown[] — a typo slips and the type is lost — each fail at least one of those checks: see "Common mistakes".
